name: harvest_test_access_sessions
description: S5c: room answers, the map and the sign-in tiles of test_access_sessions, before account kinds.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model unlocked sessions

A test floor for unlocked sessions and the workstation rule (ACCESS_MODEL_PLAN.md, step 9). Eleven beats, each with a sign. Dana (north, T1 to T3 and T11) leaves her screen open when she fetches coffee; Ian (east, T4) always locks his; Priya (south, T5) is under a policy that locks at once; Omar (beyond Dana, T6) under one that locks after five game minutes; Kai (beyond Ian, T7) is knocked out at his desk; Mei (beyond Priya, T8) ducks out of sight and Tom (beyond the hot desk, T9) leaves the scene; the hot desk (west, T10) has no owner. T11: reload with Dana's session open and Ian signed in.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: run the eleven unlocked-session beats.

contents.name: Staff notice.txt
contents.text:
Staff notice (test floor).

Lock your screen every time you stand up: Windows key and L.
contents.observations: The staff notice, on every staff desktop.

contents.name: Q3 forecast.txt
contents.text: Q3 forecast: draft figures for the finance review. (T2: copy this one; it stays on the PC.)

objectives.title: Run the unlocked-session beats
objectives.description: Test only. Each task ticks when its beat's event fires.

tasks.title: T1: Dana's PC while she sits at it
T2: use Dana's open session and copy her forecast
T3: Dana comes back and her session closes
T4: Ian's PC is locked while he is away; sign in with his password
T5: Priya's PC is locked the moment she leaves
T6: Omar's open session locks after five game minutes
T7: Kai knocked out at his desk; use his session
T8: Mei out of sight at her desk: sign-in screen, no session
T9: Tom gone from the scene: sign-in screen, no session
T10: the hot desk has no owner: sign-in screen
T11: after a reload, Ian's PC still opens; Dana's session is gone

objects.name: Sign: Start here
objects.text:
Eleven beats. Dana north (T1, T2, T3, T11), Ian east (T4), Priya south (T5), hot desk west (T10).
Omar is beyond Dana (T6), Kai beyond Ian (T7), Mei beyond Priya (T8), Tom beyond the hot desk (T9). Each room has its own sign.
objects.observations: A sign on a stand by the front desk.

objects.name: Dana's PC
objects.observations: Dana's desk PC. She leaves it unlocked when she gets up.

objects.name: Dana coffee
objects.observations: Dana's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T1 Owner present
objects.text:
T1. While Dana sits at her desk, click her PC: Dana Reyes is using this PC, and nothing else happens.
She gets up for coffee within a minute of the start.
objects.observations: A sign by Dana's desk.

objects.name: Sign: T2 and T3 Owner away, then back
objects.text:
T2. When Dana walks to her coffee, click her PC: her desktop opens, signed in as her. Copy Q3 forecast.txt; it stays listed.
T3. When she walks back, the desktop closes: Dana Reyes is back at the desk.
objects.observations: A sign by Dana's desk.

objects.name: Sign: T11 Reload
objects.text:
T11 (after T4). On Dana's next coffee, open her session, then reload the page before she comes back.
Her session is gone and she is back at her desk; Ian's session at his PC is kept.
objects.observations: A sign by Dana's desk.

objects.name: Ian's PC
objects.observations: Ian's desk PC. He always locks it when he gets up.

objects.name: Ian coffee
objects.observations: Ian's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Ian's desk drawer
objects.observations: Ian's desk drawer. It isn't locked.

contents.name: Note: my sign-in
contents.text:
ishaw / Kettle-Ian-77
(the screen locks itself, so I need this)
contents.observations: A scrap of paper in Ian's handwriting.

objects.name: Sign: T4 Always locks
objects.text:
T4. When Ian walks to his coffee, click his PC: the screen is locked, so you get the sign-in screen.
His details are in his desk drawer. Signed in with his password, his desktop stays open when he comes back.
objects.observations: A sign by Ian's desk.

objects.name: Priya's PC
objects.observations: Priya's desk PC. The instant lock policy applies here.

objects.name: Priya coffee
objects.observations: Priya's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T5 Locks at once
objects.text:
T5. Priya never locks her screen herself, but this PC's policy locks it the moment she leaves.
When she walks to her coffee, click her PC: the sign-in screen, and no way into her session.
objects.observations: A sign by Priya's desk.

objects.name: Omar's PC
objects.observations: Omar's desk PC. The corporate policy locks an unattended screen after five minutes.

objects.name: Omar coffee
objects.observations: Omar's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T6 Locks after five minutes
objects.text:
T6. Omar leaves his screen open, and his coffee takes him a long time. Click his PC once he has gone: his desktop.
Five game minutes after he left, the screen locks itself: the desktop closes with The screen locked.
objects.observations: A sign by Omar's desk.

objects.name: Kai's PC
objects.observations: Kai's desk PC. He leaves it unlocked when he gets up.

objects.name: Kai coffee
objects.observations: Kai's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T7 Knocked out
objects.text:
T7. Kai is not going anywhere soon. Knock him out at his desk: that counts as leaving his desk, screen open.
Click his PC: his desktop. He stays down, so the session lasts until a reload.
objects.observations: A sign by Kai's desk.

objects.name: Mei's PC
objects.observations: Mei's desk PC. She leaves it unlocked when she gets up.

objects.name: Mei coffee
objects.observations: Mei's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T8 Hidden
objects.text:
T8. Ask Mei to duck out of sight. She is still at her desk, just hidden.
Click her PC: the sign-in screen, and no way into her session.
objects.observations: A sign by Mei's desk.

objects.name: Hot desk PC
objects.observations: A shared hot desk PC. It belongs to nobody.

objects.name: Sign: T10 Unowned PC
objects.text:
T10. Nobody owns the hot desk, so there is never an open session to use.
Click it: the sign-in screen, and no desk light.
objects.observations: A sign by the hot desk.

objects.name: Tom's PC
objects.observations: Tom's desk PC. He leaves it unlocked when he gets up.

objects.name: Tom coffee
objects.observations: Tom's coffee machine. Nobody else uses it.

objects.name: Sign: T9 Removed
objects.text:
T9. Tell Tom he is wanted elsewhere: he leaves the scene from his desk.
Click his PC: the sign-in screen, and no way into his session.
objects.observations: A sign by Tom's desk.

body.endGoal: Test only: run the eleven unlocked-session beats.
